svg.title: Muhammad Hassaan Javed, @itxcrusher. Sakura theme.
svg.desc: I build infrastructure and bounded automation for other people's production systems. Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and lately agents that act on evidence they can prove instead of guessing. Most of that work is in private client and product repositories, so what is public here is a sample rather than the volume. The contribution graph counts it. The repository list cannot show it. If infrastructure feels exciting, something is probably wrong. The goal is systems that are quiet, predictable, and uninteresting in production.

svg.text: ripple-proof audits a full captured campaign offline in

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Ubuntu, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about a minute, with Python 3.11 and nothing else. No

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Ubuntu, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: install, no account, no credential, no network call. It

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Ubuntu, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: prints every point where it refused to act.
